# Wildfire Trackers

> > Real-time wildfire tracking and monitoring across the United States with detailed maps, statistics, and active fire perimeter data.

Wildfire Trackers provides comprehensive monitoring of active wildfires across US states including California, Colorado, Texas, Nebraska, and others. The platform aggregates data from multiple sources including CAL FIRE and offers real-time tracking of fire perimeters, containment status, and nearby fire threats for emergency preparedness and public awareness.

## Real-Time Wildfire Tracking

- [Today's Active Wildfires](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f): Real-time US wildfire tracking with maps and statistics
- [About Wildfire Trackers](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/about): Overview of Wildfire Trackers platform and data sources
